items.heading: Oil Down
details: Key ingredients: breadfruit, salted meat, coconut milk, callaloo
Layer breadfruit, salted meat and vegetables in a large pot.
Pour coconut milk over the layers.
Simmer until nearly all the liquid is absorbed and the pot bottom lightly caramelizes.
Serve as a hearty one-pot national dish.

items.heading: Nutmeg Ice Cream
details: Key ingredients: cream, sugar, milk, fresh nutmeg
Heat cream, milk and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Grate fresh nutmeg generously into the mixture.
Chill the base thoroughly before churning.
Churn until soft-set, then freeze until firm.

items.heading: Callaloo Soup
details: Ingredients: vegetables, protein or legumes, onion, garlic, stock, herbs/spices and salt.
Sauté aromatics, add the remaining ingredients and stock, simmer gently until tender, then adjust seasoning.

items.heading: Roti
details: Ingredients: flour, water, salt and fat; yeast or leavening when required.
Mix into a soft dough, rest, shape or roll, then cook on a hot griddle or bake until cooked and lightly browned.

items.heading: Lambie Souse
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
